text:
jenna_events: thinking out loud — proposed webinar: 'Practical Inference Patterns: cost-aware fallbacks and demo resiliency'. target: eng + platform leads, ~45min + 15 Qs. date options: Weds 3/31 or Thurs 4/8. thoughts?
ava_marketing: love it. focus on tradeoffs (latency vs $) + concrete failover patterns. can we pull 2 short customer stories? :+1:
diego_ops: logistics notes — prefer Thurs 4/8, greenroom 30m prior. recording + captions enabled. I'll spin up a dedicated staging endpoint for demos (no noisy shared capacity).
mike_prod: demo plan sketch: primary: hosted API -> dedicated reserved pool -> fallback to lighter quantized model. show cost delta numbers live. keep a short shell snippet to flip endpoints:
```
export REDWOOD_API=api.redwood-hosted.example
# staging toggle
curl -X POST $REDWOOD_API/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-q4"}'
```
we should rehearse the endpoint swap twice.
leo_growth: inbound funnel: capture interest with a 1-click workshop signup (utm:webinar_infer_fallback). route leads by workload tag (chat, search, embeddings). add a follow-up drip with the demo notebook.
priya_infra: speakers — Tom (runtime), Mike (prod demos), Elena (CS customer story) sound good. I'll take a 5m slide on autoscaling and routing policies.
tom_runtime: can do a couple slides on KV cache behavior and batching impact. will prepare 1 chart: latency vs batch size. pls share target sequence length distribution if you want the chart tuned.
elena_cs: i'll tighten up the customer anecdote — 90s slide + 1 bullet on measurable outcomes (cost -20%, tail latency -30%). need customer clearance by 4/1.
ava_marketing: messaging: headline options — 1) "Keep LLMs online and cheap: fallback patterns that work" 2) "Making inference predictable: SLOs, fallbacks, and real demos" prefer 1 for social.
jenna_events: run order draft (45m):
1) 0:00-0:05 - intros and why this matters
2) 0:05-0:15 - customer story (Elena)
3) 0:15-0:30 - demo walkthrough (Mike + Tom) — do the live endpoint swap mid-demo
4) 0:30-0:35 - infra patterns (Priya)
5) 0:35-0:40 - cost math and optimize checklist (Ava)
6) 0:40-0:45 - wrap + CTA to hands-on lab + signup
7) 0:45-1:00 - live Q&A
jenna_events: rehearsal schedule: dry run Mon 4/6 10am PT (full run), tech check 4/8 9:30am PT (greenroom). please RSVP to calendar invite.
diego_ops: note for rehearsal — demo account keys rotated daily on staging. I'll add a health-check command we run 10m before show: `curl /health && ./smoke-demo.sh`
mike_prod: add fallback test: simulate high latency on hosted with `tc qdisc` and confirm automatic routing to dedicated. will script it so we don't do destructive ops during live show.
ava_marketing: promo plan — teaser post 2w prior, speaker mini-profiles day before, benchmark snippet (image) 3 days prior. runway for paid ads: start 7 days before.
leo_growth: lead routing: create a set of tags: ["webinar_infer_fallback","workload_chat","workload_embeddings"] and map to SDR queues A/B. we'll export registrant list to Marketo + auto-tag.
opsbot: calendar invite created by jenna_events for 2026-04-08 16:00 UTC. attendees: jenna_events, ava_marketing, diego_ops, mike_prod, priya_infra, tom_runtime, elena_cs.
jenna_events: action items: Ava - draft social & image by 3/25; Elena - customer clearance by 4/1; Mike & Tom - demo script & smoke tests by 4/4; Diego - staging endpoint + healthcheck by 4/5; Leo - funnel + tagging by 3/29. I'll send updated run order post-dry run. :rocket:
ava_marketing: ack — will post the 1-pager and a short abstract for landing page by EOD.
jenna_events: thanks team — will loop back after dry run with exact timestamps. :thumbsup:
